title: LIVING A CLEAN LIFE IN A DIRTY WORLD

sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning”: everything in the scriptures was written for us to learn from.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” Our patience and our comfort come from the scriptures, and our hope, when we read them, is the kingdom.

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” The scriptures tell us to come out of her. Come out of what? Out of Babylon, and Babylon is America.

Her sins are her politics, her religion and her so-called holidays. A big one is coming right now, Thanksgiving. Some will feel, I cannot tell my family no, I have to partake of it. Do that and you are a partaker of her sin, and you will not get the kingdom. There is a choice to make: you either pick the Most High or you pick Satan.

It does not say pick up and leave America. It says come out of America’s sin, her filthiness, her evilness, her darkness. Destruction is coming to this place, and some of our people are going to get caught up in it.

precepts.why: Come out of what? “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils.” That is speaking of destruction: the Babylon we are told to come out of is the one that is falling, and the rest of the chapter shows it is no old Babylon but this place, America.

“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire.” These are the plagues of verse 4 that the Most High’s people are not to receive. This is not the old Babylon, because the old Babylon never burned with fire. This is the judgment coming to this place.

“For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her. And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her”: the whole world. That is trade. America is around 400 million people, while China and India are over a billion each, yet America’s GDP is far higher. Every country on the earth wants to trade with America; America is the center of the earth when it comes to trade. Every country has committed fornication with her and lived well by her.

They “shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”: they are going to see America burning. Trading with America does not mean they like America. They hate this place. For the first time the whole world is seeing America for what it is, because she has done so much evil to the earth and to these countries, and the Most High is revealing how evil this place is.

sense.text:
We are trying to live a righteous life, but evil surrounds us wherever we go. We try to be that light, but all around us is darkness. That is America, and because America influences the whole earth, the whole earth is in darkness. Everybody wants to come here; this is the center, where Satan’s seat is.

“And be not conformed to this world”: we as Israelites, the believers, are not to be conformed to this world. “But be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind”: we have to have a different mindset.

The only thing that can transform us as a people is the Bible. Religion cannot transform our mind. Politics cannot. Celebrating Christmas, Thanksgiving, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, all this garbage cannot. All of these are man-made. The only thing that can transform our mind as a people, as a nation, is the scriptures, so that we may prove “what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.”

“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world.” That seems almost impossible, because we live in the world. But God says, do not love the world, neither the things in it. “If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.” That is a heavy scripture: if you love the things of this world, you are not going to get the kingdom.

Some come every Saturday, say they are Israelites and keep the laws, and as soon as correction comes they hate it: I used to be an Israelite. There is no such thing as used to be an Israelite. That is like going to your father’s house and saying, Dad, I used to be your son. Being an Israelite is who you are; it is in your DNA.

What has really happened is they have said, I don’t want to be part of this family no more, Messiah; I love the world; there is so much out there I have not experienced yet. That is what this class is about: living a clean life in a dirty world.

“Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.” Without being converted there is no entering the kingdom. Hold on to that as the scriptures go on.

“If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.” In this walk there is going to be sacrifice. You cannot get the kingdom if you are not ready to sacrifice; you are going to have to sacrifice something.

“For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.” Find it where? He is talking about the kingdom. You have to be ready to sacrifice everything; that is the only way to get the kingdom.

Traveling all over the world to teach and wake up our people is a big sacrifice: time away from your family, time away from your job. Those are sacrifices, but they are very little to pay to wake up your people, and you have to be able to make them.

“And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household. He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.” This is read because of what is about to happen in the next week or two, the holidays.

Some love their children and everybody else more than Messiah. We are supposed to be the light of the world, the light in a dark place. But some do not want to get mom upset, daddy upset, their brothers and siblings upset, so they celebrate with them. That is loving father and mother more than Christ.

“And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.” Your cross is being willing to sacrifice that family for this truth. Your cross might be your son, your wife, your husband, your job. For some it is the weed and the crack you used to get high on: that is the sacrifice, the discipline, to get this, because you want to be that light, that example in a dark place.

You cannot be both. Some actually believe one day they can be light and the next day darkness. It does not work like that.

“He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.” You are going to find it in the kingdom. Everything here in this captivity is little, garbage, compared to what is waiting for us. The question is, do you believe that? Whatever it is that keeps you from reaching the kingdom, cut it off.

We have to be set apart. “But as he which hath called you is holy”: the Most High who called us is holy, and he called us to be holy. Holy means separate. So if you say you are separate, when mama calls about Thanksgiving, you tell her you cannot celebrate it with her.

Young men who live with their parents: be wise. Do not go back and forth with your parents about these wicked holidays, or they will throw you out. Something simple: No, Mom, I’m not going to be here, I’m going to be with the brothers, don’t wait for me. You do not have to give all the details. And when you are with the brothers, turn off your phone, because Thanksgiving and Christmas are when the family pressures you most, especially the young men just coming in. Unless you have another place to live, leave them alone.

“So be ye holy in all manner of conversation.” The way you talk should change. It is not just putting on your fringes and reading the Bible; your conversation, at your job and everywhere, should change. Family should look at you and say, I see some change in that man, brother; sister, I see some change in you, what are you into? They should want to join you, not you join them. You are supposed to be that light, that example.
“Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.” We are to be holy, separate, because God is holy.

precepts.why:
Here is where it is written: “For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy.” Sanctify means to set apart, or to declare holy. It is the same thing: set apart.

We are a holy people, a set apart people. “Ye shall be holy” means you shall be separate, “for I am holy”: because God is holy, we shall be separate.

sense.text: “Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord.” Some are not peaceful. If you do not follow peace with all men, you are not holy, and you are not going to see the kingdom. That is a heavy, powerful scripture.

“Lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you”: some have a root of bitterness on them, and if you do not overcome that spirit you will not see the kingdom of God. That is why some cannot control their anger. You are bitter towards your wife, bitter towards your husband, sleeping in the same bed with that person every night and bitter towards them. You will not see the kingdom of heaven.

“And thereby many be defiled”: that spirit will defile you. How many times must you be counseled about the same thing? Some have bitterness towards the brother and sister sitting next to them, yet come every Saturday and say shalom, happy Sabbath. You are wasting your time here. Whatever bitterness you have against a brother or sister, fix it, or you will not see the kingdom.

“That ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.” That is your damn service. Some want a cookie because they keep the law, because they mopped the floor, because they went to camp: you guys don’t appreciate me. You are here to do a job; do your damn job. You never tell the white man at your work to appreciate you.

We must separate ourselves and get that mindset. When you come into the truth, you are not the same person. We might breathe the same air, but we are not the same person. That old negro been long gone.

“And be not conformed to this world” goes with the scripture read at the opening of the class, love not the world. Do not conform your mind to this world, because this world is going to pass away. We are not fighting to get this world; we are fighting to get the kingdom.

“But be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.” It is not only your clothes or the way you carry yourself that must change; your mind must change: the things you used to do, the way you used to think. That is part of repenting. If you have an anger issue, control it, or you are not going to get the kingdom. If you are one of those brothers who used to get high, smoking coke, smoking weed, your mindset must be changed.

“That ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.” Every one of us has to prove ourselves to Messiah. He is not just going to hand over the kingdom; we prove ourselves by study and by doing the work. You cannot be that same old negro who walked in here five, six, seven years ago with the same mindset. Some say, Deacon, I cannot be perfect. Oh yes, you can, or else you are not going to get the kingdom of heaven.

Putting away the old man. “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away”: the old sin. “Behold, all things are become new.”

If you used to be an old hoe, old things are passed away. If you used to be an old pimp, a child molester, a drug dealer, a crackhead: old things are passed away. You cannot live a dirty life in a dirty place. You have to live a clean life in a dirty place. You are a new creature, brother, sister.

“Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth.” Mortify means kill, and your members are sin: kill that sin.

“Fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence”: concupiscence is deep sexual desire. You might have a sexual desire to become a carpet muncher, lesbianism; you have to kill that. Some have the desire to sleep with another man; kill that. Some want to sleep with two women at the same time; that is an evil sexual desire, and you have to kill it.

We are living in a dirty world, and you cannot be part of it. Some want clean water in a filthy cup. If the water is clean, the cup had better be clean too. This is America.

“For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience.” We are the children of disobedience, because this was written for us, and the wrath of God is going to come on the children of disobedience.

That is the destruction read in Revelation coming on this place, and some of our people are going to get caught up in it. That is why verse four there says to come out of her, my people: come out of America’s sin, filthiness, evilness and darkness.
“In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.” We used to walk in fornication, uncleanness, concupiscence and covetousness. But we no longer live in them, brothers. We have repented.

“But now ye also put off all these.” Verse five says to kill these; verse eight says you also have to put these away. “Anger”: some have serious anger issues and cannot control themselves. A brother who cannot keep his hands to himself and puts his hand on his wife; a sister who does not know how to shut the hell up and knows how to get on that brother’s skin. A sister who thinks that if her husband does not put a hand on her he does not love her has an evil spirit. A wicked woman is given to a wicked man, because both are evil. Brothers, learn how to walk away. You can control yourself teaching in the street among the most rebellious people, yet cannot control your anger with a big-mouth woman? Overcome that spirit or forget about the kingdom.

“Wrath” is also anger. “Malice” means hatred. Those are the things you have to get over.

“Filthy communication”: some have filthy communication at their job. When you get together it should be about the scriptures, building each other up; not what you think about this sister or that sister, not sports. Those are filthy communication, and you should put them away.

“Lie not one to another”: some are among the biggest liars. “Seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds.” You cannot put on the new man until you get rid of the old man; every single deed of the old man has to die.

Ninety-nine percent of us have a past life, the life we lived before we came into the truth. You cannot use that to say, that’s how I am; oh, she knows how I am. He knows you used to be that. You aren’t that no more. You are the sons and daughters of the living God now.

“And have put on the new man.” Now you are a soldier, an officer of 10, 20, 50, a captain, a deacon. You put on that new man, and you have to be an example to the brother and sister next to you. If you used to be that gossiping sister, kill it; you cannot still have that spirit after five, six, ten years. Some sisters have never heard of a soft answer. It takes a strong spirit to be quiet and a weak spirit to always run your mouth, especially against your husband. Kind words can get you anything you want from that man. Use kind words with the husband you have, not just shalom, deacon, happy Sabbath here and a pit bull at the house.

“Which is renewed”: that is the same scripture in Romans about renewing our mind. When you come into this truth you have to renew your mind. Whatever trash and garbage you learned in the world, replace it with the good things now.

“Renewed in knowledge”: the knowledge is the law. “After the image of him that created him”: that is Christ, who created you. We have to become like Christ; our mindset has to become like Christ’s mindset, and Christ’s mindset has no hate and no anger.

Still putting away the old man. “That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man”: the former conversation is the old man. “Which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts”: corrupt with religion, corrupt with Christmas, Thanksgiving, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day.

“And be renewed in the spirit of your mind.” The scriptures keep repeating themselves. This is the fourth scripture read that says the same thing, renew, renew, renew, and that was done on purpose: they all say to renew our mind.

“That ye were the servants of sin.” There was a time when all of us were working for sin, and some are still working for sin. “But ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.”
“Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.” Now that we are made free from sin, because we killed the sin, we have become the servants of righteousness.

precepts.why:
What is righteousness? “And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments.” That is our righteousness, brothers: keeping the commandments.

So being the servants of righteousness means that now we work for the Most High God.

sense.text: Cleanse and sanctify your life. “Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.”
“Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.” Lord, blot out all my sin. Those are our prayers, brothers; those are the things you should say in your prayers.

“Create in me a clean heart, O God”: Lord, take away that evil heart, that wicked heart, that sinful heart, and give me that new heart, that righteous heart. “And renew a right spirit within me”: Lord, I have some evil spirit; renew a right spirit within me.

“Cast me not away from thy presence”: Lord, do not get rid of me. “And take not thy holy spirit from me.” It is a fearful thing when God takes his holy spirit from you. It has happened many times to mighty brothers, and now they are on social media talking crazy. Is that the same brother? Yes. God just removed the holy spirit from him.
“Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation.” We have to pray for the joy of Messiah: Lord, take away that anger and give me your joy.
“Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.” After you have done all these things for me, Lord, then I will go and teach sinners your ways.

“Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.” Only the word can cleanse us; only the law can cleanse us. Water cannot cleanse you. You’re a homo, they dip you in water, you come back a wet homo. You were a thief, now you are a wet thief; a murderer, now a wet murderer. Only the law can cleanse you.
“O let me not wander from thy commandments”: Lord, do not let me wander from thy commandment.

“Thy word have I hid in mine heart.” Messiah’s word has to be in the heart, and the heart is the mind. Whatever trash is in there, replace it with the word of God, and you cannot do that if you do not study.

“That I might not sin against thee.” When you replace the trash with the word of God, it keeps you from sinning against Messiah.

“Submit yourselves therefore to God”: submit yourself to Messiah. “Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.” If you resist sin, sin is going to flee from you. But some love working for sin, and believe they can work for sin and work for Messiah. It does not work like that.

Remember the scripture in Revelation about the lukewarm whom Christ is going to spew out: spew out means he is going to kill you. You are on both sides: here on the Sabbath, but also in the club, in the bar drinking, smoking weed, sleeping around. It is a matter of time before Messiah has to put you to death. If you are in the midst of it, repent. Today is your last warning; repent before judgment comes.

“Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.” How do you draw nigh to Messiah? With the scriptures. “Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts”: purify your mind, “ye double minded.” Some are double minded: your body is here, but your mind is not here.

“Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness. Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.” Humble ourselves in the sight of Messiah and he is going to lift us up.

To be afflicted for this truth is a blessing. Right now all of us are in mourning. Our joy is going to be the kingdom. There is no joy here in this captivity. We live a fearful life every day: some cannot even keep the Sabbath because they are afraid of being fired, and some fear for their job when the new moon comes and have to tell some type of nonsense just to keep the Most High God’s high holidays. Black people can make something out of nothing, but there is no life here.

So we have nothing to lose. All we have to do is keep the law, and the kingdom is ours. No matter what happens, you should never find yourself leaving this truth saying, I used to be an Israelite.

Walk in the spirit and stay in the spirit. “Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” Every one of us has some type of lust. Your lust might be money; the brother next to you, women; another, another man; the sister next to you, another woman; your lust might be children, or your job. If you stay in the spirit, you shall not fulfil these, because all of these are the lust of the flesh.

“For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh.” This is war, spiritual war: one against another, positive against negative, righteous against evil, light against darkness. “These are contrary the one to the other”: they are not the same, and we have both. The question is which one is going to win. This war is not going to stop until Christ comes back.

Whatever you went through in the past made you the man you are today. Do not try to change the past; the Most High put it there for a reason. The past should inspire you to do greater things and keep you going, because you would not want to go back to it. Paul says look ahead; there are greater things ahead for us.

When you are doing the Most High God’s work, Satan will come for you. You used to work for Satan; Satan didn’t fire you, you fired Satan. You will be attacked through your wife, your kids, your past: Remember what you did in the past? Now you think you’re righteous. Do not let Satan use your past against you.
“But if ye be led of the Spirit”: led by the spirit and the word of the Most High, “ye are not under the law.” That is speaking of the sacrificial law.

“Now the works of the flesh are manifest.” Adultery is a work of the flesh, not of the spirit, and so are fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness, idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies, envyings, murders, drunkenness and revellings.

“They which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.” If you are in the midst of any of those things, you are not going to get the kingdom. A lot of us are fighting these things, but you cannot let the flesh win. Every one of us was guilty of one of these sins before coming here, but now you are a new creature. Do not let Satan use what you used to be in the midst of to bring you back or make you feel ashamed.

“But the fruit of the Spirit” is the flip side: “love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness”: sisters, hear that, gentleness. “Goodness, faith”: some lack faith. “Meekness” means humble. “Temperance” means self-control. Does a brother who puts his hand on his wife have self-control? Hell no. Neither does a sister who puts her hand on her husband.

“Against such there is no law.” These are the things we must have.
“And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.”

“If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.” If you stay in the spirit, as the Bishop always says, you must also walk in it. Stay in the spirit, brothers and sisters. You must live what you teach, and be that example in this dark world, this filthy, nasty world called America.
“There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.”

“For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh.” Under the law, the sin of adultery was not covered; that was death. Homosexuality was not covered; that was death. But under Christ, under Messiah, we can repent. “God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh.”

“For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit. For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.” If you do the things after the spirit, you are going to get the kingdom.

“Because the carnal mind is enmity against God”: the sinful man is against God, and the sinful man cannot please God, “for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.”

“So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.” Christianity cannot please God. It does not matter how many times you go to church, even from seven in the morning to eleven at night: you cannot please God.

“And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.” The body is dead because of sin because we are trying to be like Christ; the goal is to be like Christ. If Christ could do it, we can do it, because Christ did it in the flesh. It was not a puff of smoke that came down; it was flesh.
“For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die”: we are going to die. “But if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.”
“For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.” That is us: we are the sons of God.
